{{Quote|If I hadn't seen it, Master Jedi, I wouldn't have believed it!''"<br />"''I ''didn't'' see it, Commander... And I ''do'' believe it!|The clone commander and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Blind Jedi's Bluff" />}}
A '''clone trooper commander''' served on an [[Unidentified planet (Kenobi)|unidentified planet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was deployed there along with his troops to arrest the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that [[Assassination attempt on Obi-Wan Kenobi|attempted]] to assassinate [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], as a means of gaining admission to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].<ref name="Blind Jedi's Bluff" />
